request_launcher_logs.name: Request launcher logs
request_launcher_logs.message: Please attach the full launcher log found in [minecraft/launcher_log.txt](https://minecrafthopper.net/help/finding-minecraft-data-folder/).

request_world.name: Request world
request_world.message: Please attach the world file found in [minecraft/saves/<world name>](https://minecrafthopper.net/help/finding-minecraft-data-folder/).

request_f3.name: Request F3 screenshot
request_f3.message: Please attach a screenshot with the F3 debug screen enabled.

request_video.name: Request video
request_video.message:
Could you record a video and link it here?

If you are on Windows, you can use **Windows + Alt + R** to start the built-in Game Bar recorder.
If you are on macOS (Mojave or later), you can use **Shift + Command + 5** to open the built-in screen recorder.
If you do not have recording software, I recommend using **OBS Studio**.
If the resulting video is too large to upload to the bug tracker, please upload it elsewhere (for example as an unlisted YouTube video) and link it here.
